ground_truth.reference_condition: controlled overhead photo, whole plank visible, no tape measure

finding: The dominant Yardarm failure was warm countertop contamination. The prior permissive mask selected the whole photograph (approx. 220x159) instead of the plank. Saturated-core selection isolates the real plank body before length classification.
guardrail: Only 2 ft is real-stock calibrated in this build. 4 ft and 6 ft remain provisional until known examples are tested.
